item.title: 1 crew member rescued, search underway for another as 2 U.S. military jets downed in Iran
Israel strikes Beirut as U.S. warns Iran may target universities
item.summary: Israel pounded Beirut with airstrikes on Friday that the military said ‌had targeted what it calls militant "infrastructure" in Lebanon's capital, as the U.S. warned that Iran may target universities in the country as war in the Middle East rages.

item.title: Gaza family says toddler released from Israeli custody found with cigarette burn marks
item.summary: On March 19, the day before Eid al-Fitr, Osama Abu Nassar took his 18-month-old son, Jawad, to a supermarket east of al-Maghazi refugee camp in central Gaza when eyewitnesses say he approached a restricted area and was detained by the Israeli military.

item.title: Hegseth tells U.S. Army chief of staff to retire 'effective immediately' amid war in Iran
item.summary: U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth has asked the army's top uniformed officer to step down, the Pentagon said Thursday without giving a reason for the departure as the United States wages a war against Iran.

item.title: What Trump's prime-time TV pitch means for war on Iran
item.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump is telling Americans that while his objectives for the war against Iran are nearly achieved, he intends to escalate military operations for at least another two weeks.

item.title: Trump says 'core strategic objectives' in Iran are near completion, without providing precise timeline
item.summary: U.S. President ​Donald Trump said on ​Wednesday evening that ⁠Iran ⁠has ‌been decimated and that the ⁠hard part of ‌the war is done, telling Americans that his "core strategic objectives" are near completion and that the war will end soon.

item.title: Conversion therapy survivors on edge as U.S. Supreme Court strikes down ban
item.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court has ruled that banning conversion therapy for minors is a violation of free speech. But a man who once underwent the practice himself says it's about protecting vulnerable young people from serious — and sometimes fatal — harm.

item.title: Magnitude 7.4 earthquake off Indonesia topples buildings, kills 1 person
item.summary: An undersea magnitude 7.4 earthquake toppled buildings in parts of northern Indonesia, sent people fleeing from their homes, killed at least one person and generated a small tsunami Thursday.
